exclusions: All Git history and Git metadata; CI workflows and operator/editor settings
All binaries, archives, native executables, PDBs, compiled resources, downloaded dependencies and SDKs
All KSP/Unity paid or proprietary assemblies and KSP installations
All mod/pack assets and package archives, imported/decompiled binaries or sources
All private/public key files, tokens, certificates, environment secrets and actual bot/server/deployment configuration
All logs, diagnostics, player identities, universe/saves/runtime state and machine-only caches
Old handoff with deployment credentials; machine-local directory selection and copy batch helpers
Aetherfront-Source/LmpMasterServer/app.config and MasterServer/app.config omitted entirely because embedded credential-like values have ambiguous provenance
Generated test fixture outputs and historical runtime/candidate/release/backup snapshots
UnityTlsSmoke is still changing and intentionally deferred to a later reviewed source refresh
Images/icons are omitted even when upstream-owned; original project resource references may require adaptation

privacy.limitation: Heuristic static text scan; not a guarantee of absence of secrets. A regex timeout is a failing finding, never an omitted check.
